biography.value: Flame Hounds are hunters. They circle prey, use Blazing Pounce when the angle is right, and pursue routed enemies without needing instruction to do so. Against a single target they are relentless; a Summoner who calls one to chase something down and keep it occupied will find it performs that task until one of them stops burning. A Cooperative Flame Hound guarding a location patrols intelligently, using its Keen Smell to detect approach before anything is visible.

system.creatureSubtype: immune to poison, disease, exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Unconscious; immune to fire damage; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 60 ft, Keen Smell (Fortune on scent-based Perception)
system.tactics: Flame Hounds open with Blazing Pounce when it's available, then use their speed to stay adjacent and maintain fire aura pressure. They track by scent and pursue fleeing targets without instruction.
system.attacksNotes:
Bite [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 1), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 6 damage (3 + 3 Str) + 2 fire damage.
  • Margin 2: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 fire damage.
  • Margin 3: 6 damage, DR halved (round up) + 2 fire damage; target gains Singed condition.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Blazing Pounce (Recharge 5-8): If the Flame Hound moves at least 20 feet and hits with its Bite on the same turn, target makes a Fortitude [Easy] save or gains the Ignited condition. Fire Aura: Creatures that hit the Flame Hound with a melee attack take 2 fire damage.
